admin-purpose.statement: Partners can create admin users with different permissions to manage intended tenants or tenant groups; the Admins page can assign or revoke an admin's management of tenants or tenant groups.

quotes: Zscaler partners can create admin users with different permissions to manage intended tenants or tenant groups on the Management Portal for Partners.
Assign or revoke management of tenants or tenant groups to an admin.

admins-columns.statement: The Admins list shows a Login ID assigned per the admin's organization domain, the Number of Tenants assigned to the admin, and Actions (preview, edit and delete).

quotes: Login ID: A unique login ID assigned to the admin as per their organization's domain.
Number of Tenants: The number of tenants assigned to the admin.
Actions: The options to manage admins (i.e., preview, edit, and delete).

add-admin-fields.statement: The Add Admin window takes a Login ID (with a domain chosen from the organization's configured domains, forming a unique email-format login ID), an Admin Name, an Email ID, a Role template, a Cloud, Tenants from the respective cloud, Comments, and a Password confirmed by retyping.

quotes: Login ID: Enter a login ID for the admin user. Select a domain name from the list of domains configured for your organization. A unique login ID is created for the admin in an email format with the information that you provide here.
Admin Name: Enter a name for the admin to be associated with the login ID.
Email ID: Enter the email ID of the admin user.
Role: Select a role template for the admin.
Cloud: Select a cloud.
Tenants: Select tenants from the respective cloud.
Comments: Enter additional notes or information.
Password: Enter the password to be set for the login ID.
Confirm Password: Retype the password for confirmation.

admin-comments-limit.statement: The Comments field for a new admin takes additional notes or information, and its content (the page calls it the description) cannot exceed 10,240 characters.

quotes: Comments: Enter additional notes or information. The description cannot exceed 10,240 characters.

rbac-templates.statement: The Multi-Tenant Portal for Partners has RBAC role templates that can allow or restrict access to its function modules, for example full access to Tenants but view-only access to Policy Templates.

quotes: A role template in the Multi-Tenant Portal for Partners can allow or restrict access to different function modules of the portal as defined by the admin.
For example, a role template can provide full access to the Tenants page but view-only access to Policy Templates.

roles-columns.statement: The Roles list has Full Access and View-Only Access columns, where Full Access lists sections the role can access fully and View-Only Access lists sections it can view but not edit.

quotes: Full Access: The sections an admin user with this role can access fully.
View-Only Access: The sections an admin user with this role can view but not edit.

role-preview.statement: The Roles page lets an admin preview the super admin's permissions.

quotes: Preview super admin's permissions.

role-add-fields.statement: The Add Role window takes a Role Name, Permissions defined for different sections, and a Description.

quotes: Role Name: The name of the role.
Permissions: Define permissions for different sections.
Description: Add a description for the role.

role-product-templates.statement: The Roles page can create customized RBAC templates for the portal's function modules and for the products the portal manages, and assign role templates to admin users.

quotes: Create customized RBAC templates for different function modules in the Multi-Tenant Portal for Partners.
Create customized RBAC templates for products managed by the Multi-Tenant Portal for Partners.
Assign role templates to different admin users as needed.

scope-definition.statement: A scope can cover multiple tenants across various clouds and be assigned to specific admins, and admins can view and manage tenants only within their assigned scope.

quotes: Zscaler partners can create unique scopes that cover multiple tenants across various clouds and assign them to specific admins as required. Admins can view and manage tenants solely within their assigned scope.

scope-auth-service.statement: For partners migrated to Authentication Service, the Authentication Service Admin Portal manages all scope and role assignments, under Administration > Entitlements > Partner Portal.

quotes: For partners who have migrated to Authentication Service, the Authentication Service Admin Portal manages all scope and role assignments. To assign scopes and roles to admins, go to Administration > Entitlements > Partner Portal in the Authentication Service Admin Portal.

scope-columns.statement: The Scopes list shows the number of tenants covered by each scope (No. of Tenants) and Actions to edit or delete each scope.

quotes: No. of Tenants: Number of tenants covered by the scope.
Actions: Edit and delete options for each scope.

scope-create.statement: A scope covers tenants selected per cloud (the tenant list depends on the cloud selected, and Add Cloud adds more clouds); the Add Scope article says scopes are assigned to one or more admins in the Authentication Service Admin Portal as required.

quotes: These scopes are assigned to one or more admins in the Authentication Service Admin Portal as required.
Tenants: Select tenants from the drop-down menu. The list of tenants available is based on the cloud selected.
Add Cloud: Click this button to add another cloud. You can add tenants under each selected cloud.

edit-delete-sync.statement: The Editing and Deleting Items article, whose examples are configured users and policy templates, says an edit made with the Edit icon is saved with Save or Save & Sync, a deletion through the Edit icon uses Delete & Sync, and a deletion through the Delete icon ends with Confirm. The Managing Roles article ends a role edit with Save and a role deletion with Delete.

quotes: For example, you can edit or delete the configured users, or policy templates.
Click the Edit icon, as shown in the following example.
Make the changes and click Save or Save & Sync.
To delete items with the Edit icon:
Click Delete & Sync.
Click Confirm to delete the item.
Click Save.
Click Delete.

scope-assignment-unmigrated.title: How scopes are assigned to admins for partners not migrated to Authentication Service
scope-assignment-unmigrated.detail: The About Scopes article puts scope and role assignment in the Authentication Service Admin Portal for migrated partners, and the Add Admin window has no Scope field, so the assignment route for partners not migrated is not stated in the captured articles.

sync-meaning.title: What Save & Sync and Delete & Sync do
sync-meaning.detail: The Editing and Deleting Items article offers Save or Save & Sync and Delete & Sync without saying what is synchronized, to where, or when to choose Sync over plain Save.

role-sections.title: Which permission sections and built-in roles the Multi-Tenant Portal has
role-sections.detail: The roles articles describe Full Access and View-Only Access columns and a Preview super admin's permissions action, but do not list the permission sections or the built-in role names, and the preview has no further detail.
